_meta.source: paper/*.eps (vector EPS written by MATLAB R2018a)
_meta.coordinate_frame: ps = page frame of the EPS body: PostScript points, x right, y DOWN from the top of the bounding box (the file's page-setup matrix is [1 0 0 -1 0 H]). Default user space is y_user = H - y
_meta.calibration: per axis, exact least-squares line through (tick-mark position, single(tick-label value)). MATLAB places coordinates after rounding them to IEEE single precision, see tick_fit
_meta.axes_box_ps: the white axes-background rectangle. It carries the exact axis limits (limits_at_axes_box_edges, quoted to the axis resolution), while the axis lines sit at single(limit)

resolution.value_per_ps_digit: change of the data value when a ps coordinate changes by one unit of its last stored decimal (coordinate_decimals). The rounding error is half of it
resolution.single_precision_ulp: spacing of single-precision numbers at the largest plotted magnitude. The figure shows single(value), which is within half an ulp of the plotted double

comparison_guidance: panel with decimal_rounding = null: |recomputed - value| <= abs_error_bound_vs_plotted_double of the y axis. Sharper: |single(recomputed) - value| <= about one value_per_ps_digit
panel with decimal_rounding k: round(recomputed, k) must equal value_rounded. The unrounded recomputation may differ from value by up to 0.5*10^-k + abs_error_bound_vs_plotted_double
_meta.decimal_rounding: null, or the smallest k such that every plotted value equals single(a k-decimal number) within 0.75 ps digit while the probability of that happening by accident, at most ((ulp + 2*max deviation)/10^-k)^n for n distinct values, is below 1e-6.  If present, the panel was drawn from numbers given to k decimals and series[].value_rounded lists them, while series[].value and the CSV keep the direct extraction
_meta.text_decoding: tick labels are character strings in the EPS, while axis titles and legend labels are glyph outlines and are decoded with the outline codebook GLYPHS in the generator (apostrophe = cmr10 quoteright, 'fi' = ligature)
_meta.series_identification: legend sample line and data polyline with identical colour, dash array and width

csv.point: 1-based vertex index along the polyline as drawn (increasing theta)
csv.theta, value: fixed decimals per file, see csv_decimals
